dryRunMaxHours.label: How fresh the dry run must be (hours)
dryRunMaxHours.help: The switch to the new ERP model goes only after a dry run this recent that saw the same list from the ERP. If the ERP's list changed since, run the dry run again.

queuedV5Orders.label: Orders still waiting in the old form at the switch
queuedV5Orders.help: An order that never reached the ERP before the switch: send it again in the new form (one line per piece), like any new order, or keep it for a person to send from the ERP link page.

listShown.label: Rows in each list of the ERP link page
listShown.help: How many waiting orders, summaries and calls each list on the ERP link page shows.
